ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The lower part of the circuit is a common reference node. On the left is voltage source US, with the upper end marked “+” and the lower end marked “-”. The upper left end is connected through resistor R1 to the middle upper node; in the middle there is a vertical resistor R2 connected to the lower common node, and voltage U is marked across the two ends of R2, with the direction being upper positive and lower negative. The middle upper node is then connected through resistor R3 to the right upper node; on the right is current source IS, with the arrow upward, connected between the right upper node and the lower common node. Reasoning: Calculate U according to the superposition theorem. First keep only voltage source US and open-circuit current source IS. At this time there is no current in the R3 branch, and R1 and R2 form a voltage divider circuit, so the voltage contribution at the upper end of R2 is U_US = US * R2 / (R1 + R2) = 30 * 4 / (2 + 4) = 20 V. Then keep only current source IS and short-circuit voltage source US. At this time the middle node is grounded through R1 and R2, and after the current injected by the current source goes through R3 to the middle node, it divides in R1 and R2, therefore the voltage contribution of the middle node is U_IS = IS * (R1 || R2). R1 || R2 = 2 * 4 / (2 + 4) = 4/3 Ω, so U_IS = 6 * 4/3 = 8 V. Superpose the two parts: U = U_US + U_IS = 20 + 8 = 28 V.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify U as the node voltage at the top of R2 relative to the common bottom node. First keep US active and open-circuit IS: R3 carries no current, so R1 and R2 form a divider across US, giving U_US = US * R2/(R1+R2). Next keep IS active and short-circuit US: the current injected from the right must pass through R3 into the central node and then split through R1 and R2 to ground, so the central-node voltage is U_IS = IS * (R1 || R2). Substitute US=30 V, IS=6 A, R1=R3=2 ohm, R2=4 ohm, then add U = U_US + U_IS.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路的下方是一条公共参考节点。左侧是电压源 US，标注上端为“+”、下端为“-”。左上端通过电阻 R1 连接到中间上节点；中间有竖直电阻 R2 接到下方公共节点，电压 U 标在 R2 两端，方向为上正下负。中间上节点再通过电阻 R3 连接到右上节点；右侧是电流源 IS，箭头向上，连接在右上节点和下方公共节点之间。

推理：按叠加定理计算 U。首先只保留电压源 US，将电流源 IS 开路。此时 R3 支路无电流，R1 与 R2 构成分压电路，所以 R2 上端电压贡献为 U_US = US * R2 / (R1 + R2) = 30 * 4 / (2 + 4) = 20 V。然后只保留电流源 IS，将电压源 US 短路。此时中间节点通过 R1 和 R2 接地，电流源注入的电流经 R3 到中间节点后在 R1、R2 中分流，因此中间节点电压贡献为 U_IS = IS * (R1 || R2)。R1 || R2 = 2 * 4 / (2 + 4) = 4/3 Ω，所以 U_IS = 6 * 4/3 = 8 V。两部分叠加：U = U_US + U_IS = 20 + 8 = 28 V。

method.method_draft: Treat R2 as the load and remove it temporarily. Find the open-circuit voltage at the central node by superposition. With only US active and IS opened, no current flows through R1 or R3, so the open-circuit node voltage contribution is 30 V. With only IS active and US shorted, the 6 A source current flows through R3 and then R1 to ground, so the central node voltage contribution is IS*R1 = 12 V. Thus Vth = 42 V. Next deactivate sources to find Rth looking into the R2 terminals: US becomes a short and IS becomes an open, leaving only R1 to ground, so Rth=2 ohm. Reconnect R2=4 ohm and compute U = Vth*R2/(Rth+R2).
